reviews.text: Had Lenk Tree Service come and trim back a large maple tree and a smaller apple tree. Decent price and good communication with the crew. Did a nice job and good clean up afterwards.
reviews.author: Thomas K.

reviews.text: Quote was lowest of 3 received. Easy to work with. They completed our sewage hookup, on site system abatement, and lawn restoration in a few hours! They also coordinate and included payment for SEO inspection!
